FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: New weapontags
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Adds a couple of weapon tags that can be used to block a weapon from appearing in the weapon list for mercs.

patchNoteLines.li: Add "FCWeaponBlocklist_Merc" weapontag to block a weapon from being choosable for mercs
Add "FCWeaponBlocklist_Craft" weapontag to more generally block a weapon from being crafted
